a.lede: After a shocking downfall, Nvidia’s CEO is out of a job. WIRED’s Lauren Goode explains what that means for the world’s most critical chip company, the AI industry, and Jensen Huang himself.
a.title: Jensen Huang Is Gone. Now What?

b.lede: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
b.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
